---
name: 💡 Feature idea
about: Propose a feature or enhancement before committing to a formal RFC. Use this for RFC-light discussions.
title: "[Idea] "
labels: idea
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? What is the current behaviour, and why is it insufficient?

## Proposed solution

Describe your proposed solution at a high level. You do not need to specify implementation details — this is a discussion, not a design doc.

## Alternatives considered

What alternatives have you considered? Why did you reject them?

## Context

- NimRTC version: <!-- e.g. v0.11.0 -->
- Platform: <!-- e.g. Windows x86_64, Linux aarch64 -->
- Relevant modules: <!-- e.g. audio3a, ICE, SCTP, etc. -->

## Questions for reviewers

List any specific questions you want feedback on.

---

**Note:** If this idea gains traction and requires an architecturally significant change,
a maintainer may suggest opening a formal RFC. See [`docs/rfcs/`](docs/rfcs/) and [`.github/DISCUSSIONS.md`](.github/DISCUSSIONS.md).
